```{r}
#| label: raw 
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-dpi: 400
#| fig-align: center

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_bw())
set.seed(100)

setwd("/workspaces/7993_Mic_Psori/results/stats")

all_gen <- read.table("../../data/snp_raw.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T, check.names = F)
all_gen[all_gen == ''] <- NA

snp_filt <- read.table("../snp_filtered.tsv", row.names = 1, header = T)

rs1076160_info <-  snp_filt %>% 
    rownames_to_column('SampleID') %>% 
    dplyr::select(SampleID, rs1076160) %>% 
    rename(numeric_rs1076160 = rs1076160) %>% 
    left_join(all_gen %>% rename(coded_rs1076160 = rs1076160) %>% 
        dplyr::select(SampleID, coded_rs1076160))
head(rs1076160_info)
```
